entries: {DISASTER:strikes} hit {place}, and {first} was the first at {landmark}.
{first} found {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, and it was on no manifest.
{MESSAGE:physical} arrived from {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, asking {first} to come to {landmark}.
{SOMEONE:human,!plural} vanished {MANNER}, and {first} was the last to see it.
The {rival} blamed {SOMEONE:human,!plural} for {DISASTER}, and {first} doubted it.
{SOMEONE:!plural} came aboard {place} {MANNER} and asked {first} for help.
{first} found a door open at {landmark} {MANNER}, and nobody inside.
